requirements.description: Develop and validate fit-for-purpose multisensory biodiversity data integration systems, enabling omics-based and in-situ data harmonisation and integration with remote sensing data from space or sub-orbital platforms, as well as socio-ecological and climatic data, for enhanced assessment of ecosystem condition and degradation and predictive modelling of biodiversity trends at international, regional and European scales.

Develop concrete technical capabilities able to answer diverse use cases across terrestrial, freshwater and marine ecosystems in Member States and Associated Countries, identifying and prioritising critical biodiversity knowledge gaps and their data needs with a focus on predictive analytics and the use of AI.

Develop demonstration and verification cases focusing on specific ecosystems under the EU ecosystem typology and habitats, including ecotones, identified as under pressure or as restoration priorities, taking account of socio-economic pressures and ensuring the cases are relevant to EO applications such as AI-assisted ecosystem and habitat mapping.

Deliver FAIR data, harmonisation workflows and processing protocols supporting data integration from genome to space, and verify the use of generated datasets on identified analysis needs, linking observation data to socio-economic, climate, agriculture, forestry, fisheries and environmental data and to relevant data infrastructures.

Contribute to consensus and implementation of joint definitions of data collection, metadata and processing protocols, data quality and harmonisation of standards, enabling the integration of observations from genomes to space.
The proposal may consider services offered by European research infrastructures. This scope element is permissive, not required.
